purpose: Read-only evidence-qualified cabin-to-setpoint adherence, stabilization and overshoot analysis of the returned climate timeline.
primaryGoal: Understand comfort consistency while distinguishing measured support, excluded rows, continuity gaps, censored windows and unavailable analytical layers.

dataSources.routeEvidence: internal\api\router.go:4116-4118 mounts GET /climate/ and /climate/latest; no double client prefix.
dataSources.behavior: History from the signal-log timeline; forward-folded state is explicitly not independent sensor measurements. Server defaults to now minus seven calendar days through now and supports ParseDateRange start/end. Current hook supplies neither bound, forwards AbortSignal, enables only for a nonempty vehicle ID, preserves the climate/history/vehicleId key and uses safeArray.
dataSources.trust: Page derives historical DataState and separates fatalError, retained refreshError and paused fetches. No age threshold is invented.
dataSources.units: Cabin/setpoint temperatures remain Celsius and durations seconds in analysis. Temperature differences use convertTempFromSI(value)-convertTempFromSI(0) at the display boundary; duration display uses useUnits. Confidence/share ratios become displayed percentages only in presentation.
dataSources.limits: Backend timeline implementation, live requests, database filtering, row completeness and actual payloads were not exercised.

dataSources.endpoint: Indirect fleet lookup through useVehicles; its request implementation was not inspected.
dataSources.behavior: URL path/query selection precedes persisted selection then first known fleet vehicle. Page consumes vehicleId without adding a local selector. workspaceScope allows the vehicle picker for this route but not the date-range control.
dataSources.limits: Fleet loading/error behavior and actual header selection interaction were not exercised.

dataSources.sourceOwner: Pure domain derivation from returned rows
dataSources.behavior: Ordered row eligibility, first-returned duplicate policy, chronological sorting, mean available front-row setpoint, HVAC normalization, qualified step intervals, browser-local hour splitting, active fragments, sustained-band windows, disclosed confidence shrinkage, exact identities and capped newest-first window directory. No synthetic telemetry.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Embedded VehicleOperationalBrief plus retained/source-period boilerplate repeats across analytical panels. This already has an existing domain adapter; it is not justification for another KPI or trust renderer.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Continue using VehicleOperationalBrief and SourceAvailabilityBrief; any future simplification must retain per-panel source explanations and specialist formatters.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Gate, Quantile, Identity and Detail share small label/value tile structures but carry distinct affected counts, equations, balance states and boundary metadata.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Keep domain-local composition with existing Text/MetricLabel/Grid. Do not invent a universal tile without independent consumer evidence; preserve every distinct field.

sourceObservations: PageLayout uses w-full/min-w-0 and a container context; LayoutCard retains min-w-0 and wrapping headers.
Compact OperationalBrief stacks metrics at default width, then uses sm two columns, md three and six at 1920px.
Window directory uses two/four/eight detail columns and a bounded internal vertical scroll region; methodology uses one/two/three columns.
Three charts have explicit 280/300px heights and shared responsive sizing; hourly support uses two/four/six/eight columns.

issues.detail: The detail directory starts at two columns and reaches eight based on viewport width; long translated boundary labels/date values have no explicit break-words/min-w-0 on the local Detail value. Narrow allocated widths and text zoom need deliberate review.
issues.fix: Use a one-column narrow-container fallback and wrapping values through the existing Grid/Text contracts, keeping all eight fields and newest-first ordering. Verify before changing a breakpoint.
issues.evidenceLimit: Source risk, not an observed overflow.

sourceObservations: LayoutCard labels its shared Card with generated heading IDs.
All three charts supply ariaLabel and data/dataColumns through EmbeddedChart for the shared fallback-table pipeline.
Window entries use ol/li; methodology uses article; meaningful outcomes include text, not color alone.
Decorative icons are aria-hidden. QueryStatus has a polite loading status and refresh-error alert with shared retry Button.
FadeIn honors the existing motion preference in source; actual reduced-motion and low-bandwidth rendering is unverified.

issues.detail: The max-height overflow-y-auto window list has no explicit accessible scroll-region label or focus target. Entries themselves have no focusable controls; keyboard access to all capped entries must be checked on supported browsers.
issues.fix: Exercise keyboard scrolling first; if the region is not reachable, add a localized named focusable region using existing focus styling without changing list semantics or deleting the internal scroll.

states.loading: Evidence ledger loading flag, QueryStatus polite spinner/banner and panel-specific Skeleton heights; sections remain mounted.
states.empty: Resolved zero rows produce an explicit endpoint-empty statement. Chronological/sample/interval/run/window gates provide distinct passive explanations; counts are valid zero only after resolution.
states.fatalError: QueryStatus mounts QueryError with refetch; SectionBody provides passive source-unavailable guidance rather than replacing the entire page.
states.refreshError: Retained summaries remain visible; QueryStatus offers a warning and retry; briefs receive retained=true.
states.offline: Paused query invokes VehicleSourcePause, distinguishes retained versus unresolved data, and does not infer an empty endpoint.
states.partial: Availability matrix and evidence requirements distinguish analytical layers. No fabricated score for absent active samples; neutral components are disclosed domain methodology, not sensor measurements.
states.stale: Page passes climateQuery to shared header freshness. DataState is used for failure/paused retention, not a new arbitrary age threshold.

issues.detail: The Exact balance badge is outside SectionBody, so the summary derived from data ?? [] can announce balance before any endpoint result. The window-directory shown/total/omitted caption is likewise outside its gate (WindowDirectory:72), and methodology's warning publishes zero row/sample/window counts without query state (Methodology:114). These are unresolved-source values presented as observations.
issues.fix: Keep each section, its description and methodology visible. Gate only source-derived badges/count sentences on resolved retained evidence; otherwise render a localized unknown/loading/paused explanation. Resolved empty arrays may still report actual zero counts.

visualIssues.detail: Six KPI contexts use fixed cyan, indigo and purple accents, with a semantic score branch in emerald/amber/rose. This introduces unnecessary multihue emphasis and fixed light-toned icon styling across themes; no explicit neon/glow/pure-white classes were found in the root or page-specific TSX components.
visualIssues.fix: Use the existing muted text token for decorative metric icons; retain localized score confidence text and use established severity tokens only where score meaning is genuinely communicated. Do not replace every icon with a new bright accent.

visualIssues.detail: Three separate single-series plots select unrelated saturated blue/purple/amber entries from chartTokens.series (tokens.ts:401), despite having no multiseries differentiation need.
visualIssues.fix: Use an existing subdued theme-aware token consistently for ordinary single-series evidence, retaining an amber semantic hue only when justified by outcome meaning. Coordinate any global palette change with its shared owner; do not alter persisted user chart/theme choices or remove series.

visualIssues.detail: The embedded domain brief still mounts OperationalBrief's GlassPanel with border/surface/shadow and its own title, while the host LayoutCard already supplies panel/title chrome. This repeats in multiple metric-heavy sections and adds repeated Review details actions.
visualIssues.fix: Have the existing brief owner add a real embedded presentation variant rather than creating another renderer. Preserve metrics, rich captions, source trust, accessible section headings and every details drawer/action; page adoption follows shared acceptance.

architectureIssues.detail: This dated analysis does not consume useRangeState. /comfort-consistency is absent from RANGE_ENABLED_PATHS, and useClimateHistory accepts only vehicleId. Header range preferences/from/to URLs therefore do not scope this page, although the climate handler supports start/end.
architectureIssues.fix: Integrate the existing header range owner with both bounds through an optional bounded climate-history hook contract and range-aware query key. Keep the existing seven-day unbounded hook behavior for other callers; preserve current default semantics through an explicit integration decision rather than silently widening the data window. Update methodology to disclose the actual requested period. Never add a local range picker or client-filter only loaded rows.

priority.first: Correct pre-resolution observational badges/count captions without hiding sections.
priority.next: Coordinate range ownership and a shared embedded brief contract, then restrain decorative icon/chart hues.
priority.acceptance: Targeted state/formatting regression tests and browser QA after implementation; this audit is not runtime acceptance.

dependsOn: climateHistory query-key extension only for bounded requests
requiredSharedChanges.constraint: No routing/config/shared edits authorized to this audit. Existing other hook callers are not inventoried; preserve their current behavior.

competingImplementations.detail: Domain state gating complements, rather than replaces, shared deriveDataState, SourceContent, Skeleton and QueryError. Its analytical requirements are specific to this summary.
competingImplementations.fix: Keep domain eligibility gates separate from shared query trust; do not introduce a second asynchronous-state framework.

sectionNames: Hourly comfort consistency and observed support
Exact source, interval and window accounting
actions: Use workspace header vehicle selection without adding a competing picker.
Retry fatal, refresh-failed or paused climate history through existing refetch.
Shared header freshness refresh where supplied by PageContainer's query.
Review details for ten operational/source-summary briefs; preserve drawer metrics, narratives, provenance, focus behavior and close controls.
Three chart image-export toolbars: PNG/SVG/copy-image through the existing ChartContainer controller.
Scroll newest-first stabilization directory; retain its disclosed cap and omitted count.
Access page subtitle help and shared chart fallback tables.
preservation.actionLimits: No page business mutation, annotation configuration, zoom/legend persistence, explicit fullscreen or CSV exportData supplied. Do not invent those as existing capabilities. Browser export and drawer functionality unverified.
dataInventory: Six headline metrics: adjusted score, analyzed samples, observed active seconds, within-band duration share, duration-weighted deviation, stabilized-window share.
Eight source fields/support counts and percentages against unique timestamp-valid rows.
Coverage endpoints/span, median/P90/max cadence, known-HVAC share, cadence and long-gap counts.
Nine mutually exclusive returned-row outcomes and timestamp reconciliation.
Within/above/below/observed duration, weighted deviation, observed/candidate pairs and exclusion categories.
Twenty-four browser-local hourly buckets, within-band share and observed duration support.
Deviation sample bins; mean, median, P90 and duration-weighted mean.
Paired/one-sided sample counts, mean/median/P90 setpoint disagreement and above-gate share.
Active/in-band/outside/hot/cold/stabilized/censored fragment counts, median time-to-band and overshoot distribution.
Four score components and weights, sample/window confidence, raw and adjusted index, neutral shrinkage explanation.
Eight analytical thresholds and observed affected counts.
Seven exact accounting identities plus five boundary categories.
Eight independently gated availability layers and support values.
Six methodology explanations and source-support disclaimer.
dataBehavior: Raw payloads/query keys/retries/cancellation and selected vehicle remain authoritative.
Forward-filled climate rows are timeline states, not independent measurements.
First-returned duplicate retained; invalid rows and missing timestamp/thermal/HVAC evidence accounted independently.
Default comfort band 1.5 C; maximum positive interval gap 1800 s; sustained-band gate two samples; target-shift gate 2 C; disagreement gate 1 C.
Directory default cap 80, bounded maximum 200; cap affects display only, not aggregate calculations.
Step interval uses eligible interval-start state; no arbitrary bridging of oversized gaps or absent eligible start evidence.
Browser-local hourly splitting is existing analytical semantics; do not silently change timezone behavior.
Score weights 50/25/15/10 percent; missing agreement/stabilization evidence stays disclosed neutral; confidence shrinks toward 50.
Celsius differences are converted without an absolute-temperature offset; seconds use saved display formatting.
Unknown stays unknown; real resolved zero counts survive. Retained rows survive refresh failure/offline pause.
All panels remain reachable regardless of query state; no content removal justified by visual simplification.

evidenceLimits.backend: Handler and route source only; no requests or database inspection.
evidenceLimits.validation: Read-only audit; no TypeScript, tests, full lint, build, Git operations or source/config/catalog/queue edits.
evidenceLimits.auditScript: Inspected audit.sh but did not execute it: its mandatory project-wide TypeScript phase conflicts with this Phase0 contract's serialized validation rule. Bounded source patterns were inspected directly instead.
